item.title: 55 Kids Receive Christmas Presents From The Flomaton Police ‘Fill The Cruiser’ Toy Driver
item.description: This Christmas, 55 children in Flomaton had presents thanks to the success of the Flomaton Police Department’s “Fill the Cruiser” Toy Drive. With donations from area businesses, a Scout troop and other local organizations, the gifts filled the town council chamber prior to distribution. Photos for NorthEscambia.com, click to enlarge.
